statements.text:
Absent clear regulatory guidance, bad actors are too often utilizing AI technologies to deceive consumers through highly realistic automated calls.

I'm leading the effort to crack down on this malign practice by introducing the CLEAR Voices Act.

⬇️⬇️
https://t.co/xi0jM23sAH

Far too many Americans have fallen victim to the emerging threat of AI-generated robocalls, particularly our seniors. If we fail to update existing laws and regulations to keep pace with technological advancements, 21st-century consumers will continue to face these threats, leading to potential fraud or privacy invasions. The CLEAR Voices Act is a commonsense approach to crack down on this malign practice, maintain public trust, and protect hardworking Americans.
statements.venue: Press release on re-introducing the CLEAR Voices Act

statements.text: AI is no longer science fiction. It is here, and it is significantly transforming industries and workplaces. Optimistically, this technology may boost productivity, empower workers, and put the American Dream within reach for more Americans. [...] But as AI becomes more common in the workplace and fuels American innovation, we must ensure that workers are protected, too.
statements.venue: Opening statement as Chairman, House Education & Workforce HELP Subcommittee hearing 'Building an AI-Ready America: Adopting AI at Work'

statements.text: The bottom line is that AI can create opportunity without compromising fairness or safety. We appreciate the insights our witnesses will offer about how we can ensure that innovation serves people—not the other way around.

statements.text: No better place to hold this hearing than Augusta, Georgia. If the United States intends to win the AI race, we must invest in the infrastructure, workforce, and innovation needed to maintain our competitive edge. https://t.co/PIPFo8VqDf
statements.quoted:
Chairman @RepRickAllen of the Subcommittee on Health, Employment, Labor, and Pensions delivered the following opening statement during today’s field hearing titled, “Building an AI-Ready America: How AI Is Creating Opportunities Across America's Workforce.”

Read more ⬇️
https://t.co/pejjPNfSw1

statements.text: At the same time, we cannot take America’s leadership in AI for granted, because it is not guaranteed. Other nations are investing aggressively in AI, and this technology is evolving at an incredible pace. If the United States intends to win the AI race, we must invest in the infrastructure, workforce, and innovation needed to maintain our competitive edge. We also need better data about how AI is impacting our workforce so policymakers can make informed decisions. And we must think carefully before we impose unnecessary regulations that could stifle innovation or undermine America’s competitiveness.
statements.venue: Opening statement at Education & Workforce Committee field hearing in Augusta, GA

statements.text: As we consider the role of AI in the workplace, we should be wary of a one-size-fits-all approach. The needs of a family farm are not the same as those of a hospital, a manufacturing plant, or small business. Congress must pursue flexible policies that allow businesses to adopt AI in ways that best suit their industry and workforce.
statements.venue: Opening statement at Education & Workforce Committee field hearing in Augusta, GA

statements.text: There was no better place to hold today's field hearing on AI in the workplace than Augusta, Georgia. AI has the potential to be a powerful engine of economic growth. [...] If the United States intends to win the AI race, we must continue these critical discussions and ensure this technology remains a tool that serves Americans.
statements.venue: Press release statement after Augusta field hearing

statements.text:
We should be wary of a one-size-fits-all approach when considering the role of AI in the workplace.

The needs of a family farm are not the same as those of a hospital, a manufacturing plant, or small business. Our goal should be to foster innovation while ensuring that businesses of every size—in every corner of the country—can benefit from AI.
